judge.rationale: The candidate stopped mid-implementation, leaving several facets of its own `.lore/dod.md` unchecked and committing harness artifacts (`.lore/dod.md`, `.lore/test-commands.yml`, `scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs`). In `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`, it is missing the WeakMap cache for function-valued tool schemas, the warning log on validation failure, and the required one-line JSDoc comment on `execute`. Furthermore, `ajv.errorsText` can include allowed enum values or pattern details depending on the constraint, and the candidate did not update `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, or `example/weather-tool.ts` as required by the acceptance criteria. Several required tests (e.g., extra properties pass-through, dynamic schema updates, unknown tool throw, and the test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`) are also missing, and tests were fragmented across three new test files (`registry.acceptance.test.ts`, `registry-input.test.ts`, `registry-static.test.ts`) instead of `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
